data.summary: Reviews for Southernwind Pools appear overwhelmingly authentic. The high volume of detailed, specific reviews across all star ratings, spanning many years, indicates genuine customer experiences. While there is a rating discrepancy between Google/Houzz and Yelp, the content of negative reviews on all platforms shows consistent, credible complaint patterns (especially delays and communication). The positive reviews are also detailed and varied, suggesting a contractor with high-quality outcomes but occasional process and customer service failures. There is no strong evidence of systematic review manipulation.
fake_signals: Some 5-star reviews are generic and lack specific project details (e.g., 'Great experience', 'Highly recommend')
A few 5-star reviews mention multiple neighbors also using the company, which could indicate incentivized reviews, but is not conclusive
authentic_signals: High volume of detailed, specific reviews across ratings (names like Clay, Adam, David, project types, timelines like 'under seven weeks', 'nearly two years')
Consistent complaint themes from multiple independent reviewers over many years
Mix of emotional language in both positive and negative reviews (frustration, excitement, disappointment)
3-4 star reviews provide balanced, credible perspectives acknowledging both quality and process issues
Company has been in business for 42 years, lending credibility to review volume
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google/Houzz ratings (4.5/4.8) are significantly higher than Yelp (3.6). This is a common pattern where Yelp attracts more critical reviews and Google is more curated by the business. The BBB A+ rating indicates good complaint handling but doesn't reflect service quality directly.

reviews.text:
We just finished our second pool build with Southernwind Pools, and once again, they exceeded our expectations! After moving out to the country, we weren’t sure if they would take on our project, and we are so grateful they did.

From start to finish, the entire process was incredibly smooth—honestly even more streamlined than our first build with them back in 2019. The process was professionally done from start to finish. The pool build was completed in under seven weeks, which was such a pleasant surprise.

The design phase with Clay was just as impressive. He truly listened to our wants and must-haves and turned them into a design that fits our family and our property perfectly. Never hesitated to make small changes (after we had time to overthink things) until it was perfect.

John managed the project and did an outstanding job. His communication was clear, consistent, and timely, and he kept the scheduling of all the trades moving without a hitch.

We couldn’t be happier with our experience and highly recommend Southernwind Pools to anyone considering a build—whether it’s your first time or your second!
reviews.author: Jennifer Corwin

reviews.text: Our experience with Southernwind Pools, and especially Clay Wager, has been nothing short of exceptional. We recently completed a major backyard renovation in Dallas with a large pool, outdoor living area, and outdoor kitchen. Southernwind managed the project with the expertise you’d expect from a large, experienced company, but with the relationships you’d expect from a small, family-owned business. Our project designer, Clay Wager, did much more than design our project. He worked with us to create what we wanted and needed as a family. As first-time pool owners, he both listened and provided expert advice. Additionally, he was present for us throughout the entire project. When we noticed a chip in a tile, he was the one we called and quickly had it fixed under the outstanding warranty Southerwind provides. Any large construction project is going to have its glitches along the way, but I’m glad we had Clay to move the process along. Perhaps most importantly, we believe the project is now perfect. After using it for a summer, it was exactly what we wanted, and all our guests have been highly impressed with it. The project took a while to complete, but Southernwind completed our backyard within budget and with minimal inconvenience to our family. I would highly recommend Southernwind Pools to anyone looking to renovate their backyard.
reviews.author: Christopher Salinas

reviews.text: This is the second time we have used Southernwind to build a pool and we had a wonderful experience again! Southernwind focuses on building less pools than many of the pool builders in DFW, but each one of their pools is custom and high quality. This was one of our requirements for a builder. We worked with Clay on design and David was our project manager. Clay provided the unique design we were looking for to make our backyard stand out. Once the project was handed over to David he built the whole thing in 8 weeks from dig to plaster! One thing that really stands out to me is how well they communicate throughout each stage of the project. Communication was one of my main requirements and they exceeded my expectations. Overall I would highly recommend Southernwind for any pool project.
reviews.author: David Vinson

reviews.text: Great options for the homeowner to choose between stone, counters, turf, etc. They ensured final punch list was completed to our liking and approval. Finished project looks great and now we've extended our living area outside.
reviews.author: Bill Hubble

reviews.text:
We had the pleasure of working with Adam at Southern Wind Pool, and we couldn’t be happier with the results! From start to finish, the entire process was smooth, professional, and stress-free. Adam and his team demonstrated incredible attention to detail, top-notch craftsmanship, and a commitment to excellence that truly set them apart.

Not only did they deliver exactly what we envisioned, but they also exceeded our expectations in every way. The quality of work, communication, and customer service were all exceptional. If you're looking for a reliable, talented, and professional pool company, look no further than Southern Wind Pool. We highly recommend them!

Thank you, Adam and the entire team, for an amazing job!
reviews.author: Heather Krebs

reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience with Southernwind Pools from start to finish. Adam was our designer, and he created the most beautiful pool for our backyard. He really listened to what was important to us and designed a pool that not only met—but exceeded—our expectations. Our backyard is absolutely stunning now!
If we ever move within the Dallas area, there's no question—we will 100% work with Adam and Southernwind Pools again. In fact, some of our neighbors also used Adam and Southernwind, and their backyard looks incredible too!
Adam also connected us with fantastic landscaping contacts, and we couldn't be happier with the results. Charlie was our project manager and did a great job keeping everything on track. He was consistently checking in and always available to answer questions or explain details.
Both Adam and Charlie were professional, responsive, and a pleasure to work with. We truly couldn’t have asked for a better experience or a more perfect pool. We love it!
reviews.author: Dallas McCutchan

reviews.text: I can't say enough great things about our experience with Southernwind Pools. We absolutely LOVE our dream back yard!!! You can get a very basic pool from any of the big name companies around here, but my husband and I wanted something modern and unique. Our designer Clay Wager had an incredible eye for design and helped completely transform what we thought was possible in our yard. We do not plan to move, but if we ever did, there's no doubt in my mind we'd be calling up Clay and team to design any future pools/outdoor spaces.
reviews.author: Jennifer Cortez

reviews.text: Great experience with Clay and the entire crew at Southernwind Pools.  They were easy to communicate with and stayed on schedule.  I highly recommend Southernwind Pools.
reviews.author: Lisa Day

reviews.text: We couldn’t be happier with our new pool.  The Southernwind team was professional, communicative, and easy to work with.  The final result exceeded our expectations.  Our backyard has already become a favorite spot for our family.  Highly recommend to anyone considering building a pool!
reviews.author: Robby Markose

reviews.text: We had a very challenging pool remodel but Joseph Sampsel went out of his way  to find the perfect coping for our pool when other companies didn't even want to attempt to remodel it correctly.  He definitely went above and beyond and had a very positive attitude throughout.  He was able to find the perfect stone for the coping with the depth that we needed, which we originally thought we might not ever be able to find since the depth they were going to have to work with was less than what most stone is.  He also found the most beautiful tiles for the spa and inside of the pool as well.  Our remodel turned out better than we could have ever expected thanks to him and Southerwind Pools. I highly recommend him for any project you might have.
reviews.author: Julie Mortillaro

reviews.text: After 26 years we decided to redo our pool. We talked with several contractors and happily selected Southwind Pools.  Charlie was very helpful in the design and construction process, responsive to our questions and requests. Milt and his team did an awesome job refinishing. New stone, tile, plaster and pump equipment—looks amazing. It’s soothing and relaxing as we float in our brand new sparkling pool.
reviews.author: Lynda Airey

reviews.text:
Southernwind designed and started the installation of our new pool in the summer of 2022. The project was extensive since we had a new build with water features and a covered patio. Our designer, Rane presented us with a beautiful design which we made only minimal changes to. He is a great designer and very easy to work with. Rane is personable and was attentive to our needs. When he presented our new design, we could not believe it was our backyard!  The end result came out exactly as presented and we are very happy with the creativity he brought throughout the design process!

The foreman for our project was JT. We can’t say enough great things about this young man! He is an absolute joy to work with. JT was on top of everything and we were very happy with how he handled all the issues and steps that needed to be done. We did have a few issues with the subcontractors but overall had a good experience with everyone at Southernwind Pools. It did seem like a longer project but as long as you set your mind on a longer completion timeframe, you won’t be as anxious to get it completed. There was some issues that arose throughout the duration but was expected, with a project of this size.

We highly recommend Southernwind Pools! No, the process won’t be perfect but they are a company that delivers, with integrity and honest practices and at the end of the day, that’s what really matters. We absolutely love our new outdoor living space!
reviews.author: Carole G

reviews.text:
I built a pool with Southernwind Pools in 2019. I really liked the design that Adam Johnson came up with to maximize the space in my small backyard. He's definitely an asset to their team. There were some construction/timing challenges that we worked through with John/Charlie and I was ultimately very happy with my pool and my new back yard.

In 2020, the coping starting to disintegrate due to some issues with their limestone supplier and Chad/Charlie replaced all of the coping around my pool and made it right - I really appreciated that.. it could have been a lot more of a headache.

In the years that they've serviced my pool since, their team has been great. I really like Larry and his service team. I've had a few issues and they've always been very responsive and their prices seem fair compared to some of their competitors. Jesse and the technicians that have been out to my property to conduct ongoing maintenance and filter cleans have been great too.

During the most recent freeze in Dallas, John, the owner, called me to tell me that the freeze guard on my system might not be on.. they were proactively checking systems that they service. Fortunately, the system was on and working well, but there was some trouble with the wifi connection. I really appreciated his phone call.  It was above/beyond my expectations.
reviews.author: Graham Rumble

reviews.text:
Working with Southernwind was a no brainer. We compared designs by several other pool companies and the vision Adam Johnson presented was exactly what we were looking for.

Adam took the time to listen to our thoughts and was able to build upon them to bring to life the backyard oasis we were looking for and plan on enjoying for decades to come.

When Adam brought our vision to life via video we assumed he’d move on and hand it off to the Project Manager and he’d disappear. Nothing could be further from the truth. He was there weekly to see our vision come to life. That’s what you get with Southernwind- a cohesive team approach to the build. We never felt like we weren’t sure what the next steps were. Our build was completed on time and on budget.

From the front desk, to the design, and to the build, Adam and Southernwind showed they have what it takes to make anyone’s back yard dreams come true.
reviews.author: Christian Janssen

reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience building our pool with Adam and John at Southernwind. They were knowledgeable, helpful, and we're so pleased with the process and the results. They were really responsive to all of our questions and concerns. We picked Southernwind because we felt that they would do our project the right way - and they really did. Thanks so much for our beautiful pool and patio!
reviews.author: Rachel Cooke

reviews.text:
We highly recommend Southernwind Pools and Joey Sampsel. Joey came out quickly to help our older pool that had plaster discoloration, older tiles and stonework repair.
Joey was always available to answer questions.  He was there to make sure everything was going well.  The pool tile, plaster and surrounding areas look amazing. He made the process easy and stress free. Excellent Job by Southernwind Pools.
reviews.author: Paige Grojean

reviews.text:
We are under construction (3/21/18).  Crews have been here working very hard on our project.  From the design experience with Moses, to our project manager Ben, to our scheduler Angela, truly this has been a great experience thus far.
Almost every good weather day has been used and Angela communicates frequently who will be on-site and what they will be working on.  The crews work diligently and it is evident that they take pride in their craft.
Southernwind has provided us with superior quality of products and superior people.  We couldn't be happier to say that we've had such a great experience considering some of the nightmare stories we have heard from friends who happened to choose other companies.  If you are looking for a pool builder, do your due diligence and research many as we did.  We are so happy that we chose Southernwind Pools to be our builder and I think you will be happy, too.
We are in the home stretch and will post final photos once available.
UPDATE 7/10/18
Turned out great!!  It was completed mid-May and as mentioned in previous review, everything with the build went very smoothly!  We couldn’t be happier!
Our landscape architect is Ted Nichols with Focal Pointe Landscaping- he did an incredible job and it really finishes our build. It wouldn’t be the same without the landscaping to complete it.  Ted was great to work with and was able to give us great ideas as we weren’t quite sure what would look best. Way better than we anticipated it would be!

The only blemish on an otherwise smooth build is the punch list (which was not long at all- just a few little things which we couldn’t be happier about) after all said and done. It has taken them a little longer to wrap up a few details, but I attribute it to them being busy with other builds and only a set number of crews to take care of the minor details.  Beyond that really minor issue we fully recommend Southernwind. Quality, craftsmanship, care, communication all throughout!  We have loved every bit of the pool this summer and really had a great experience with everyone involved at Southernwind!
reviews.author: Julie Boardman

reviews.text:
We used Southernwind to redo our pool - new plaster, tile, and coping for both the pool and spa. I do want to say we are thrilled with the results, it's a beautiful pool now. But the process was not great. What was a originally promised to be a 1-2 month project took almost 5 months to complete. Communication was severely lacking - emails and phone calls would go days or weeks before being answered and then not even answer all of our questions prompting follow ups that again would take days or weeks to hear from them again.

Again, we love the work and are happy with the quality. But the process was a very negative one. It really felt like we were the "cheap" project no one wanted to deal with.
reviews.author: Ashley Meller

reviews.text:
Southernwind Pool did an awesome job with our pool installation.  We came in with a clear vision and Mike was fantastic at making that vision come to life.  He was precise with every detail and made sure we had the design exactly the way we wanted it from the beginning.  When it came to installation, Ben was equally awesome with keeping track of all of the trades (and we had many because of all of the terrace work).  If something wasn’t right, it just took one call and Ben was on it.  There were a few times when I’d see something that didn’t look right and he’d make a special trip over to ensure mistakes weren’t made.  We even did an add on landscaping project with their sub contractor and the mix between the pool project and post pool landscape interfaced very well.  Overall, the team was outstanding, the only challenge was in the transition to self maintenance and the availability of information about how the system operates.  But again, Mike ensured we were satisfied all the way to the end.
Big thanks to Southernwind Pool.  We can’t wait to enjoy our pool this summer.
reviews.author: Julie Purdy

reviews.text: Southernwind Pools and Clay Wager hit a grand slam! We could not be happier. Clay is a phenomenal designer. His entire team took care of us from start to finish and made the process fun and enjoyable. Clay's attention to detail was far superior than his competitors. His vision and design concepts captured exactly what we were looking for. From our original consultation, Clay distinguished himself well above the others. He listened to what we were looking for and then exceeded our expectations with his design concepts, attention to detail, and vision for our backyard. Any questions that came up, it was a quick call to Clay and it was solved. Would recommend Clay and Southernwind Pools for any project.
reviews.author: Patrick D Pinson

reviews.text: Please don't disregard this post as a bot-generated review.  I am a real person with real experience with Southerwind Pools.  My pool was a custom design build on a 30 degree-grade lake lot.  To call it a challenge is an understatement.  The design was complex and the build was literally an up-hill climb.  The professionals at Southernwind did NOT disappoint.  John and crew delivered a five-star pool and spa with infinity edges, water wall, state of the art systems and knock-out water features.  The flaming water pots define the experience at night.  Travertine decking for the patio and lower sun deck.  While the pool/spa is insane, the post-production service is white glove.  My advice:  Be willing to pay a little more for Southerwind's diligence, quality and service.  Looking forward to the next one with Southernwind...
reviews.author: Jim Goodman

reviews.text:
We had high hopes when we began our pool project with SW Pools. Our initial experience was promising—our designer truly listened, visited our property, and delivered an incredible vision for what felt like a dream backyard oasis. Unfortunately, that designer left the company shortly after, and from there, the experience went downhill fast.

What was supposed to be a premium project (we spared no expense) turned into a frustrating, drawn-out ordeal. The execution dragged on for nearly two years, and even now—two years after what they called “completion”—we are still dealing with unresolved issues. Despite providing a written checklist multiple times, as outlined in the contract, SW Pools has failed to deliver on key fixes.

We have stones that are crumbling or falling off the structure, unresolved drainage issues, and other glaring problems that were never addressed. Communication has been inconsistent at best, and promises made by John Versfelt have repeatedly gone unfulfilled.

If you’re considering SW Pools for your backyard investment, we strongly encourage you to look elsewhere. We regret trusting this company with such a major project. The end result has been more stress and disappointment than relaxation or enjoyment.
reviews.author: Lainey Hayward

reviews.text: I recently hired Southernwind Pools to replaster my pool, replace the tile and coping, and install a handrail. I could not be happier with the company. All work was completed in a prompt, professional manner, and everything looks great. I especially appreciated that all my communication was directly with the owner John Verselt, who promptly answered all my questions and kept me fully informed. All workmen showed up exactly when John said they would.
reviews.author: Audrey

reviews.text:
We’re very happy with our Southernwind pool!  Clay did a great job on the design and John has been very good to work with.  The install was professionally done and they made sure I was satisfied every step of the way.  Ongoing support has been great.  John is very attentive in promptly answering any questions that we may have and is always willing to come out to help if needed.  Southernwind also seems to have a great deal of strength in their relationship with their suppliers.  Southernwind has requested a couple of equipment warranty issues for us, and the timeliness in the response they get from their suppliers has always been very quick.

The automated in-floor system they install is a huge asset that keeps the pool very clean without having to own or run a pool sweep.  Overall, I believe Southernwind uses top of the line equipment and materials which is a definite plus.

Bottom line, a very pleasant experience with a company who seems to still value customer service.
reviews.author: Ricky Reynolds

reviews.text: We searched numerous pool companies…requested quotes by all and it seemed like we were a number. Then came Rane With Southernwind Pools. We knew we would have a small service fee (Southernwind Design Fee), although we were willing to take the leap of faith. WOW!! Rane hit it out of the park. My wife was so impressed - I knew we found our crew. Partnered with JT!  BAM…it’s coming together.
reviews.author: Credit Solutions

reviews.text:
We absolutely loved working with Southernwind Pools.  The quality of work was top notch.   The time table for getting things done was done quickly and efficiently. All people that came to complete the work were kind and by the end of the day if the work hadn’t been done you wouldn’t have known they were there.  Each day everything was cleaned up and kept neat.
We are so happy with the work and with the company.  Charlie was top notch in communication.  We already have referred him out to others and our neighbor’s pool work starts next week!  Give them a call for sure.
reviews.author: Annelise Ford

reviews.text: Southernwind designed and built my pool in 2022/23. I worked with a few other companies and they had the best design and overall value proposition. During and after construction, if an issue arose, John and team made sure I was properly taken care of at every turn. On the service side, Larry (manager) is absolutely top notch and always makes sure I am happy with the service. John and Larry’s consistency in making sure that the customer is happy and treated fairly is the main reason why I am leaving a 5 star review, they’ve earned it.
reviews.author: Angelo Quatrano

reviews.text: We are currently under construction and can’t wait for the finished product. Certainly, the weather has delayed some timelines, although who can control that - only GOD can. That said, we are extremely impressed with the design Rane created for us & the current outcome of our backyard oasis, spearheaded by JT.  Stay Tuned for more…
reviews.author: Brandie Pacheco

reviews.text:
We had postponed this review for quite some time, but we would like to acknowledge Southernwind Pool. In 2017, we reached out to Southernwind Pool, among four other reputable companies in DFW, and in 2022, we decided to move forward with installing a pool. As first-time pool owners, we were initially overwhelmed, but Moses, the designer, put us at ease. Despite our sloped backyard, Moses did an excellent job with the design.

Like any construction project, there were challenges, but Southernwind promptly and professionally resolved them. Building a pool is like building a house; delays due to materials, labor, and weather are inevitable and part of the process. It's normal to have moments where you wish you had done things differently. One aspect we regretted was not adding more lights, so it's advisable to discuss lighting options with your designer based on your pool's size. Apart from that, we are thrilled with our pool. Even after completion, we had numerous questions, and Greg kindly came over to explain the systems to us.

During a recent winter storm, our pool had a 2-inch sheet of ice on top. We contacted Southernwind Pool for guidance, and Greg promptly called back to advise us on what to check and reassured us. Working with Southernwind has been a pleasant experience.
reviews.author: KimLan Le

reviews.text: When we started our complete backyard overhaul (rehab and remodel existing pool, add outdoor kitchen and living space, fire pit, etc), Southernwind was the only company that was able to capture and expand on our vision for our backyard remodel. The team was great to work with and the results were incredible. They really delivered the “wow factor” that we were looking for and we love entertaining guests in our beautiful outdoor oasis!
reviews.author: Leslie Loyd

reviews.text: It’s been 2 years since our project completion. From the beginning of our design phase with Designer Clay Wager we have always been taken care of. Now, 2 years later, Southerwind is still offering great service. Nothing but great things to say about their Service Manager Larry Mendez who is constantly available to help us navigate pool ownership.
reviews.author: Garrett DuBois

reviews.text: Clay Wager is amazing to work with! He listened To all our requests and ideas and was able to come up with an amazing concept.! He is really an exceptional designer and is able to think outside the box and come up with ideas that are not like all the others. Southernwind was a pleasure to work with. They finished our project on time and in budget I would not hesitate to recommend them to anybody!
reviews.author: Chad Clark

reviews.text: Southernwind built an amazing pool for us and we rarely have repair issues but when we do they are prompt, professional and great to work with. Highly recommend them !
reviews.author: Cheryl

reviews.text: Garrett did an exceptional job cleaning our pool filter today. Answered questions and took the time to explain things. He was friendly, attentive, and thorough. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: S Kelt

reviews.text: I have been a service customer with them since they built my pool in 2007. They are excellent on keeping my maintenance going so I have a sparkling pool all the time. Working with Charlie, we have kept my system up to date so I can stay current on technology and extend the use of the pool. I highly recommend their services. They are a caring one stop shop for all things related to having a great pool.
reviews.author: Tammy Waverling

reviews.text: Southernwind Pools built our pool in 2019 and we've had them handle all of our service since then.  They respond quickly to any problems with the pool and we love our weekly technician Garrett who cleans/services our pool!
reviews.author: Lisa Boone

reviews.text: I am the envy of my neighborhood! John Versfelt and Southerwind Pools made my experience seamless and enjoyable. When making an investment in your home of this magnitude, accept only the best! John cares as much as anyone I have ever worked with on any project and it truly shows in the final project. I sit outside and am surrounded by quality and beauty, which perfectly compliments the style of my home. 1000% satisfied!!!! Thank you Southerwind Pools for my backyard oasis!!
reviews.author: Jackie Anderson

reviews.text:
We are so please with the purchase of the pool and the service we continue to receive from Southernwind Pools. It is amazing how spot on the real pool looks when compared to the one our designer, Moses Campos, helped us create. We did hit a bit of a snag during the project, as will happen when constructing something in the real world, but John, the president of the company, stepped right in and made sure everything went smoothly.

Honestly, and I think they even told me this before we started, but it does really interrupt your regular life when they are doing a project like this in your backyard. Especially if you have dogs and are used to just letting them in and out as needed. Your yard, fence, landscaping and maybe even irrigation will look nuts for a little bit, but here… 5 years later, I have zero regrets. Zero.

This has been the best purchase ($$:joy ratio) that we’ve ever made and feel we got a real value with the technology options Southernwind offered. Everything is so easy to operate and program. Thank you, Southernwind, we are so happy with how this project turned out.
reviews.author: Lane Rackets

reviews.text:
We shopped around for the best pool contractors in the DFW area. We don't have the biggest backyard, so it's probably a relatively small job—and some contractors treated us that way, never even calling back after inspecting our backyard space. Southernwind was on it tho!

Fast forward to the present and our pool is done, beautiful and a joy to experience. Moses did amazing custom design and the team of Charlie and Esteban handled the day to day work and overseeing subcontractors. Both are a joy to work with. We're very happy with the results!
reviews.author: trey clark

reviews.text: We had Charlie Burton manage our pool build in 2019 and to this day he still takes my calls or texts with any random question I may have. Our family values that type of relationship and can not say enough about how amazing Charlie is to work with and how many times he has gone above and beyond.
reviews.author: Trey Henderson

reviews.text: I’ve been working with these guys for years, one of the best pool builders in the Dallas area. Reach out to them, in a short period of time you will find out you’re working with a great team! High quality construction at a great price. John Verfelt Adam Johnson and the other team members are awesome to work with! Very knowledgeable.
reviews.author: Wil Theinfloorguy Preas

reviews.text: Very satisfied with the service and quality of work received from Southernwind Pools.  We did some renovation on our pool that is approx. 12 years old.  Mark R. was great in helping us pick out tile/stone... having the showroom was extremely helpful.   Mark was great at giving us our options and honest recommendations.  Crews were timely and respectful.  Looking forward to having them help us with our outdoor kitchen... Very highly recommend Southernwind Pools.
reviews.author: Deb Delatte

reviews.text: Southernwind Pools provided a great design incorporating their creativity in design while also implementing what we wanted. Construction process was managed efficiently and we ended up with a great pool and outdoor living areas.
reviews.author: Michael Hesse

reviews.text: We were initially super happy with our pool. After 5 years, not so much. The quality just isn't there. We had several repairs done under warranty and at 5 years the LED lights are out because the modules they used were junk and will cost close to $2000 to replace because they have to be completely rewired under the patio. The swim jet stopped working due to electrical problems. A tile has fallen off.  I had to scrape glue off the tiles from sloppy work at initial install.  Better quality was expected for the small fortune an in ground pool costs. They're good people and work hard, but some of their subs and the Pentair parts are really bad.
reviews.author: Mark McClurkan

reviews.text: We can't thank Southernwind Pools enough for all of the work they put into our beautiful pool. The entire team including Moses, Angela and Drew truly went above and beyond to help us get everything done in a timely manner. The communication throughout the process was especially on-point. This pool building experience was the best we've had and we will continue to highly recommend Southernwind to friends and family.
reviews.author: Aaron Lewis

reviews.text: After moving from the Los Angeles in 2018 we made a decision that we wanted to build a pool.  After interviewing a number of pool vendor and verifying references we chose Southernwind Pools.  Mike Calonne our pool consultant was very patient and understanding as we began to design our pool.  We initially started out with a simple rectangular pool that morphed into a free form design.  Mike helped us and made recommendations through the process.  We also decided to add a spa   Using the pool design software Mike was able to show us a visual representation of what the pool was going to look like.  We began the actual work in the fall of 2018.   Southernwind Pools assigned a project manager that stayed on top of all phases of the project.  The rain made the project a little challenging.   However, after each phase Southernwind sent in their crew to clean-up the construction area.   The pool came out exactly like the visual diagrams we viewed during the deign phase.  Needless to say,  we love our pool and are very grateful that we chose Southernwind.
reviews.author: Bob Goldstein

reviews.text: Southernwind did an exceptional job with our pool expansion project.  From design to build and construct we could not be any happier.  Mark the PM is incredibly passionate about creating pools and he did an amazing job delivering on time.  I would recommend Southernwind to everyone.
reviews.author: Chad Mitchell

reviews.text:
Super impressed with Southernwind Pools! Rane designed an amazing pool for our yard. Angela, our Construction Coordinator, kept us informed/educated us on each phase of the process.  And, I really have to brag on Esteban, the Project Manager. He has been right on top of everything… checking in on the contractors and crews each time they were here.

I was told by friends that have had pools built, “get ready to hurry up and wait.”But, that’s not been the case for us! They broke ground Feb 25th and we’re on track to swim in May! Today, is March 31 and they are pouring the decking as I right this review. They will clean up and spray the pebble tech (plaster) soon. The only hiccup is the water feature… it’s on back order (which isn’t their fault).

We are very happy with the design by Rane and the execution by Esteban building it out. I highly recommend Southernwind Pools.
reviews.author: Chad Sirratt

reviews.text:
A BIG SHOUTOUT to Chad and Nubia Dains of Southernwind Pools! These folks lead their entire team in getting every homeowner’s outdoor oasis done with zero to minimal amount of stress and worry!

This award-winning custom pool builder focuses on quality, not quantity. They communicate with their customers clearly and effectively. They listen to their client’s creative ideas and respect their delicate taste. They take great pride not only in their contemporary designs but also in building mutually respectful relationships with their clients and vendors. To them, every pool build is an opportunity to make their customers happy and change their lives for the better. And boy, do they take that responsibility seriously!

More power to this wonderful and amazing team of pool experts at Southernwind Pools!!!
reviews.author: Richie Davis

reviews.text: We had an amazing experience building our pool with Southernwind! They did exactly what they said they were going to do when it was supposed to be done. We love the end result and highly recommend using them.
reviews.author: Megan Post

reviews.text:
Update 6/11/2024: Your management team has known of our issues and concerns for more than 3 years. We still haven’t heard from the construction manager you refer to in your response below.
Original review: Careless pre-construction engineering and design resulted in a mess! We paid top dollar for a disaster. Southernwind continues to refuse to address the problems.
reviews.author: Ashley Lowrance

reviews.text: Southernwind has been an excellent customer of my company dating back to 1989. Personally, I have had the pleasure of working with them since I got in the industry in 2004. Since then, I have learned to appreciate their dedication to customer service and market-leading quality and innovation. It only takes a quick glance at their photo gallery to see that they build beautiful backyards. As nice as the pictures are seeing the projects in person really is eye-opening. It is refreshing to have a builder pushing the envelope and not just building a cookie-cutter pool that any other builder in town could do. Their employees are great with customers  from the owner on down and are always very helpful, especially the sales crew of Chad, Mike, Moses, and Roger. They go out of their way to make sure you get the backyard of your dreams coupled with great customer service, which in the end is what every customer wants and deserves. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Nick Cureton

reviews.text: We are a new distributor to the Dallas area and when we started calling around asking about pool builders, Southernwind Pools kept coming up as the number one Pool builder in DFW. I have to say, after working closely with everyone at Southernwind this is very true. Their professionalism, dedication to superior service and availability to contact has been nothing short of amazing. The staff is so reliable and driven to be not only a top knotch pool builder, but also a company that truly loves what they do and takes pride in every step of the process from details on what the homeowner wants to being up to date on all the latest technology and styles. I have been in the pool business now for 32 years and I would have Southernwind Pools build my pool above anyone else. Great company and Amazing employees.
reviews.author: Jeff Parker

reviews.text:
Great experience through the entire build process and even beyond into cleaning and support. Our design consultant wowed us with a great design and some features/elements that we didn't think of on our own.  John (the owner) kept us well informed during the construction process and was just a text message away if we ever had any questions.  And even the support has been excellent.  We had a big pool party for our daughter's birthday party and one of the kids broke the fountain pole in the spa.  Totally not Southernwind's fault - but they were out the next day and fixed it for free.

Very delighted with Southernwind and recommend them to all our friends and neighbors.
reviews.author: Richard Ellis

reviews.text: Thank you Southernwind for your work on our pool.  Hours of fun for family and friends.  Thank you for your great weekly service crew.  Its an awesome experience.
reviews.author: Angel Thomas

reviews.text: Awesome pool builders!  Great design, very helpful throughout the whole process, and they use the best contractors to ensure everything is perfect.  The stone masons especially were top notch and built exactly what we wanted!  Highly recommend!  I chose Southern Wind based on quality and reputation.
reviews.author: Collin Scott

reviews.text:
I highly recommend Southernwind Pools and will do so until I am no longer able to speak or write!!! I started off by looking at several different companies and moved forward with 3 different designers. The initial process was very trying for me because I have little free time due to hectic work and family schedules. Ultimately, I chose to work with Mike Calonne at Southernwind because he went way above and beyond the rest: 1) he bent over backwards to accommodate my crazy schedule during the planning and construction phases, 2) listened to my needs and wants and produced a breathtaking design that will entertain my kids and my friends for many years to come, 3) made valuable recommendations to provide the energy efficient and low maintenance solutions I was seeking, and 4) educated me on some pitfalls I would want to avoid no matter who I chose to build my pool.

Imagine my delight when the rest of the team was just as helpful, friendly, professional, and accommodating! They took care of absolutely everything and made sure my efforts on the project were minimal – just what I told them I needed. And, despite a very crazy rainy season last fall/winter, they finished on schedule! I continue to be super-pleased with the attention and follow-up I receive from Mike Eastes, their Project Manager, and his team (he even sent me pictures and videos of my project since I was always stuck at work and he didn’t want me to miss out on all of the excitement) and from their Service Manager, Jon Paul Stalnaker, and his team who are all very personable, responsive, and efficient. Even the President of the company, John Versfelt, checks in to make sure we’re happy – truly exceptional customer service and quality!!! My pool is spectacular and stunning, we live in our spa, and we can’t wait to take our first swim next weekend!!!
reviews.author: Jennifer LeRow

reviews.text:
You may read this review elsewhere.  I've posted it at a number of sites because I really want to acknowledge the exceptional work done by Mark Robinson and his crews from Southernwind Pools.  Southernwind was recommended to me by USI Remodeling, a company who has handled a couple of major interior jobs for us over the last dozen years.   I have a lot of trust in USI, and wanted to use a company that I could similarly trust for our pool renovation, and Southernwind did not disappoint.
The project was a complete renovation of a pool about 40 years old. The only original component that wasn't removed/replaced was the gunite shell.  Sundeck was replaced with travertine pavers –beautiful!  And the replaster looks great.  Pool equipment is all integrated and tied into the wireless network –works as advertised.
Mark works long hours to stay on top of his jobs, and is very accessible.  He was very good at identifying issues that needed to be addressed along the way to make sure that the job was done right, and there were no expenditures that we were not made aware of ahead of time.   Mark was quick to respond to texts and emails and is just a “good dude”.
So I would heartily recommend Southernwind.  They will not be your lowest bid, but you get what you pay for.  I had a “budget” re-tile/re-plaster done years ago and that did not turn out well (especially the re-plaster –inferior bonding agent used between gunite and plaster).   If you are interested in quality work carefully overseen and completed in a timely manner, Mark and his team will deliver.
reviews.author: Bob Arend

reviews.text: First of all, Roger designed the most beautiful backyard I could have imagined.  Then Mike took over and brought it to life.....He always addressed our concerns and questions and truly consider him  a customer service professional. John followed up to make sure everything was completed to our satisfaction and we have found a long-term relationship with Southernwind Pools!
reviews.author: LaShonda Kirkland

reviews.text: I reached out awhile back to see if Southernwind Pools would be interested in building a pool for my family. I never once heard back from you BUT I did get on your mailing list. I receive junk mail from you EVERY week in my mail box. I'm not sure if you're aware of this, but it's 2020 and most companies do not send out mailings as it's terrible for the environment. I definitely do not recommend this pool builder!
reviews.author: Meryl Craft

reviews.text: I called to get some estimates and had been calling around all day. I spoke with Nubia and she made the call memorable. She thoroughly answered all my crazy questions. She seemed to really care. Her customer service was excellent! She spoke highly of the company giving me confidence their crew was going to take good care of us! Thank you Nubia!
reviews.author: Tasha Mendez

reviews.text: They are the best.... my family has been with Southernwind Pools since the 90's servicing our pool...when it came to renovating my 47 year old pool they are the only company I would trust... I  had complete confidence with Mark Robinson who walked me through every aspect of this renovation it was a huge job considering the age of the pool. Not one surprise...Mark was on top of every aspect of my project 24/7... his note to detail was beyond my expectations I am completely happy.. job site was organized and clean every night.... thanks for my beautiful pool Southernwind...ask for Mark you will not be disappointed.
reviews.author: Barby Kirk

reviews.text: As a subcontractor that has worked on many of Southernwind Pools projects, I have seen the construction process first hand.  Southernwind Pools is among the best in terms of customer service, attention to detail and customer satisfaction.  From their sales staff, to the construction supervisor to the owner, they are experts at what they do and put a high degree of importance on delivering a quality product to a satisfied customer when all is said and done.  If I were building a pool myself, Southernwind Pools would be building it!
reviews.author: Steve Berry

reviews.text: We chose Southernwind Pools for our extensive remodel this month.  Received quotes from 4 different local companies and were most impressed with the service of SWP.  Mark was our contact through the remodel and he really sealed the deal for us.  He was extremely responsive to our questions and concerns both before contract and through the build process...until things started to go wrong, and then we were told to "call the office". We were having our pool remodeled with the funding from an insurance claim, so we were very clear about needing a specific and all-inclusive quote with no surprises. Lo and behold, after receiving our settlement check, we get hit with all the nickel and dime things. Things that should have been included to begin with so that we could have included them in the claim. Examples: light replacement, start up chemicals and brushing, stone seal, new spa button, etc.  Their stone guys did an amazing job, but then the power washing team ruined several areas blasting holes in the sides of the spa and leaving ugly lines along the coping where they got too close. We were told this would be handled...yet here we still sit. The PebbleTec contractors left several uncovered white spots in the pool, they said they'd send divers to repair...still no word. Also, beware of their "start up service". They skip days, misuse chemicals, and abruptly quit without telling you they're done. Just handle start up yourself or hire another company for the same fee. They never cleaned up the site and have completely left us hanging.  There are far too many options in the market to deal with this sort of nonsense. Once they rec'd our 2nd check on plaster day, we were dead to them.
reviews.author: A H

reviews.text:
I move to McKinney from Akron,Ohio 7 weeks ago. I wanted to re-due the older pool, add an outdoor kitchen, and a fireplace with a TV. I interview 4 contractors and selected Mark Robinson at Southernwind. The project started in early June and took about 9 weeks to complete. Mark was on the phone with me EVERY morning to discuss the progress of the work.We completed the entire job, from a remote location. On time and on budget. the pool is the focal point of our home. Outcome could not have been better, andI'ma tough guy to please! Highly rated. If anyone has question, please just IM me. Happy to talk to you about this
David in McKinney
reviews.author: Shirley Levey

reviews.text: All the pictures on their website are amazing! However, response time was disappointing and we were also informed that their pools start at 80k. Therefore, if you only have the space for a small pool or a smaller budget, do know that this company will not do any smaller projects. They will also charge a $500 fee for “designing” your pool. If you decide to move forward, it’ll go towards the total cost. But if you have to hold off on it, then you’ll loose it. The design fee seems higher than other competitors.
reviews.author: Google User

reviews.text:
I contracted  with Southernwind pools in 2016 to buy and install new pool equipment motor pump, re surface poil. Add water  feature tile and edging.  It was challenging through the entire process with the water feature stone falling foreard into the pool.  They finally brought  in someone more experienced.   The job was  not supervised  at all.   I paid them in full and when my pool maintenance guy told me they should have put my equipment  on a block and not directly on the ground they said they would be back.  Never got done.    I sent them pictures if my equipment  sinking and will get worse.  Now they say I did not contract  for this and it will cost 1000.00 to fix it.  Really. I DID not  contract for the equipment to be installed properly.    Tired of contractors  that take the money and send people not trained.   They are  not responding to my request for a written response explaining  in writing why I did not contract  to have mt equipment installed properly.   I will keep on this with whoever will listen

Update. 2 years later had to put another pool motor!  The tech said he could not see any identification on the motor and suspected I was given a used one.

reviews.text:
I am happy with the pool but recent legal issues with the owner of the company would cause me not to recommend their services to a friend. I am disappointed that the owner values his customer relations so poorly, that neither he nor his attorney will return a phone call over a very MINOR issue.

Most customers seem to be happy with this company, as was I, until I received a rude lawyer letter 5 months after the pool was completed and paid for.

You decide!

reviews.text:

reviews.text: I am extremely pleased with Southernwind Pool over the past 3 years.  The personal service I get from John and his crew is second to none.  They have been there when I needed them for questions and any service issues that have arisen.  My my next pool will definitely be a SWP.  I highly recommend them.

reviews.text: Unbelievable! The transformation of our backyard is amazing. Our team at Southernwind, Mark Robinson and Mike Calonne, went above and beyond to bring our vision to reality. The attention to detail and quality of craftsmanship was/is absolutely superb.

reviews.text: John and his crew are great. We love our pool. I couldn’t be more happy with their customer service. Moses did a great design and Charlie made it happen.

Highly Recommend !!!

reviews.text: Mark and his pool guys are awesome! We called in a concern today and the problem has already been diagnosed, parts ordered/received, and will be installed within two days! Gotta love that turn around time!

reviews.text: I am very picky, I require perfect work and I spent months interviewing and getting quotes from many local pool contractors for our project. I am so glad I went with them, they had the best price and did the best work.

reviews.text: I do not have enough words to describe how awesome this company is! They are so prompt, understanding and make you feel at home.  They have exceptional customer service! You will not be disappointed.
